attrs.label: Inhibition Timer

attrs.label: Max Configurable time

attrs.name: conTMinfcPOrFcPA
attrs.info: a configurable time, which starts with the first detected incomming Wheel.
attrs.label: Min Configurable Time

attrs.name: conTTdpDelay
attrs.info: configurable delay, defining the duration of a passed TDP and the message, that the TDP is in state TDP not passed.
attrs.label: Passed TDP Indication Delay

attrs.name: conTTdpUnidentifiedPatternDelay
attrs.info: Configurable delay, defining the duration after an undefined pattern was detected till the TDP is reported as Disturbed.
